topic: Future Lidiya R&D privacy and data-sharing controls

windchime_final.owner_recommendation: For future sensitive Lidiya R&D in a personal ChatGPT workspace, use the lower-training-exposure posture by turning off Improve the model for everyone, while treating that toggle as only one control rather than a complete IP/privacy boundary.
clarifications: Opt-out is not retroactive removal of earlier content and is not evidence of zero retention, zero operational access, zero connector exposure or zero repository exposure.
Continuity does not depend on consumer-model training participation; Home/Active/exact authority/self-backups/evidence remain the continuity substrate.
Temporary Chat is not the default persistent R&D workspace because persistence/memory is intentionally absent; reserve it for one-off cases where persistence is unwanted.
Codex or other full-environment products may have separate controls and must be verified independently before proprietary environments are exposed.
Secrets and credentials remain excluded from prompts, repositories and shared connector stores regardless of training setting.
minimum_exposure_workflow: Restore continuity from durable Home/Active/exact authority refs.
Classify outbound data; exclude secret-like and unnecessary raw corpora.

Validate externally using schema/test contract/redacted manifest/synthetic fixture plus hashes first; reveal proprietary ranges only when acceptance genuinely requires them and authorization permits it.
Keep connectors read-only and task-scoped by default.
Keep proprietary repositories private; publish only minimum validation mirrors when public reproducibility is useful.
Avoid explicit product feedback on sensitive R&D threads unless intentionally accepting the documented exception.
Retain only a compact non-secret four-control fingerprint and verification date; periodically reverify because product/connector settings can change.

m01_compaction_candidate.summary: Future sensitive Lidiya R&D: opt out of consumer model improvement where available, but independently govern product feedback, connector data paths and repository visibility. Continuity uses durable project state, not training participation. Minimum sufficient disclosure and least privilege are default.
